name: Confidence & Courage
tagline: Stand in your own power without apology.
description: Amber and orange stones traditionally worn for nerve before the meeting, the pitch, the first date, the hard conversation.
seoDescription: Confidence crystal bracelets in tiger's eye and carnelian, traditionally worn for courage. Hand-strung in Dubai with next-day delivery across the UAE.
definition: A confidence bracelet is a crystal bracelet strung from stones traditionally worn for courage, willpower and the nerve to speak up: tiger's eye, carnelian, citrine and red jasper. It is usually worn on the right wrist, the side tradition says sends energy outward. The Lionheart pairs golden tiger's eye with burnt-orange carnelian for exactly this.

faq.q: Which crystal is traditionally worn for confidence?
faq.a: Tiger's eye is the stone most traditionally worn for confidence and willpower, and carnelian is worn for courage and motivation. Together they make a warm, golden-orange bracelet that suits both men and women, which is why they are the pair in The Lionheart.

faq.q: Is a confidence bracelet a good gift?
faq.a: It is a popular gift for a new job, a graduation, exam season or a big presentation. Tiger's eye and carnelian are hard, everyday stones, and every bracelet ships in a linen pouch with a card explaining what its stones are traditionally worn for.
